linkedinReason: This is the Nostr WoT team's own published 1 minute 43 second tutorial and seven-language guide pair. It teaches users to review the destination and scope of backend and relay authentication requests before approving access.
linkedin:
A Nostr app can ask to use your identity, authenticate to an HTTP backend, or identify you to a relay. Those are different permissions.

Our 1 minute 43 second tutorial shows what to check before approving: the requesting site, the exact backend URL and method, or the relay and approval scope. The companion guides explain remembered grants, explicit denials, and how to revoke access.

This is a practical walkthrough for deciding who can receive an authentication proof from your Nostr identity.
